en_quote: In some cases, multiple regulators supervise a single organization. This occurs when an organization offers a range of regulated products or operates across international or domestic borders.
knowledge_zh: 当机构提供多种受监管产品或跨境运营时，可能受多个监管机构监督

en_quote: Therefore, regulators coordinate when conducting regulatory examinations and other activities.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构在进行监管检查和其他活动时应进行协调

en_quote: Regulators clarify their area or scope of authority so that examinations and supervisory activities do not overlap. All parties need to be clear about their respective responsibilities.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构应明确各自权限范围，避免检查和监管活动重叠

en_quote: Regulators coordinate at a policy level to ensure there are no gaps that create opportunities for noncompliance. They compare risk assessments and risk-based approaches to ensure integrated supervision.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构在政策层面协调，比较风险评估和基于风险的方法，确保一体化监管
监管机构之间共享信息

en_quote: Coordinating scheduled work allows for complementary scheduling among regulators.
knowledge_zh: 协调安排工作使监管机构能够互补排期

en_quote: Regulators might consider joint examinations for areas that warrant it to reduce the impact on an organization.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构可进行联合检查以减少对机构的影响

en_quote: If an examination identifies issues or weaknesses, the regulator informs any other relevant regulators. In some instances, regulators can pursue joint action, resulting in combined enforcement action.
knowledge_zh: 检查发现问题时监管机构相互通报并可采取联合行动

en_quote: Regulators cooperate both within a jurisdiction and internationally.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构在境内和国际层面开展合作

en_quote: Many financial institutions have international footprints.
knowledge_zh: 许多金融机构拥有国际业务布局

en_quote: Problems or risks in one jurisdiction might warrant scrutiny from regulators in another jurisdiction.
knowledge_zh: 一个司法辖区的问题或风险可能引发另一司法辖区的审查

en_quote: In Europe, AML/CFT colleges are permanent structures that enhance cooperation between different regulators that supervise cross-border institutions.
knowledge_zh: 欧洲的反洗钱/反恐怖融资学院是促进跨境机构监管合作的常设机构

en_quote: In addition, the EU’s new AML Authority will coordinate supervision among EU regulators and undertake direct supervision for the most high-risk entities.
knowledge_zh: 欧盟新反洗钱机构将协调监管并对高风险实体直接监管
